address: The Former Residence of Hsin Chih-ping, 32 Dongmen Street, East District, Hsinchu City, Taiwan
bio: This historical building featuring Japanese-style architecture was home to a famous local educator in the 1920s. Meticulously restored, it now houses an upscale eatery serving traditional Taiwanese fare with modern touches. Quality ingredients are used to craft refined creations that deliver satisfyingly nuanced flavours. With a cosy and warm vibe, TAIVII reimagines Hakkanese culinary heritage, imbuing it with fresh new notes.
